_comment: 优化项与预设的唯一数据源。C# GUI 与 PowerShell CLI 都从这里加载；修改时只改本文件。
_i18n: name/description/sideEffect 为中文（zh-CN），*En 为英文（en-US）。英文缺失时界面回退中文，绝不显示空白。详见 docs/dev/PLAN-P2-1-catalog-i18n.md。

items.name: 接电 CPU 优先性能
items.description: 将当前电源计划的接电 CPU 能效偏好设为 0（优先性能）。适用于支持自主 CPPC v2 性能调节的平台。
items.descriptionEn: Sets the current plan's AC CPU energy performance preference to 0 (favor performance). Takes effect on platforms supporting autonomous CPPC v2 performance control.
items.sideEffect: 可能增加功耗、温度和风扇噪声；仅改接电设置。
items.sideEffectEn: May increase power draw, temperature and fan noise; changes AC settings only.

items.name: 接电 CPU 最大状态 100%
items.description: 将当前电源计划的接电 CPU 最大状态设为 100%，解除该设置中的性能上限。已经是 100% 时不改动。
items.descriptionEn: Sets the current plan's AC maximum processor state to 100%, removing a limit imposed by this setting. Leaves an existing value of 100% unchanged.
items.sideEffect: 原本主动限频时可能增加功耗和温度；仅改接电设置。
items.sideEffectEn: May increase power draw and temperature if the CPU was intentionally limited; changes AC settings only.

items.name: 关闭鼠标加速
items.description: 关闭 Windows 指针精度增强，注销或重启后完整生效。
items.descriptionEn: Disables Windows Enhance pointer precision; fully applies after sign-out/restart.
items.sideEffect: 改变桌面指针手感；使用原始输入的游戏可能忽略它。
items.sideEffectEn: Changes desktop pointer behavior; games using raw input may ignore it.

items.name: 键盘缓冲区扩容
items.description: 将 KeyboardDataQueueSize 设为 50，调整键盘驱动事件队列容量。
items.descriptionEn: Sets KeyboardDataQueueSize to 50, adjusting the keyboard event queue capacity.
items.sideEffect: 需重启并检查外设兼容性；队列容量不等于输入延迟。
items.sideEffectEn: Restart and check peripheral compatibility; queue capacity does not establish input latency.

items.name: 鼠标缓冲区扩容
items.description: 将 MouseDataQueueSize 设为 50，调整鼠标驱动事件队列容量。
items.descriptionEn: Sets MouseDataQueueSize to 50, adjusting the mouse event queue capacity.
items.sideEffect: 需重启并检查外设兼容性；队列容量不等于输入延迟。
items.sideEffectEn: Restart and check peripheral compatibility; queue capacity does not establish input latency.

items.name: 键盘重复提速
items.description: 按键重复延迟调到最短(KeyboardDelay=0)、重复速率保持最高，长按退格/移动更跟手。
items.descriptionEn: Sets the key repeat delay to its shortest (KeyboardDelay=0) while keeping the repeat rate at maximum, so holding backspace or a movement key responds faster.
items.sideEffect: 打字手感变化；不习惯可在"控制面板-键盘"调回。
items.sideEffectEn: Changes how typing feels. Adjust it back under Control Panel, Keyboard, if you dislike it.

items.name: 关闭粘滞键/切换键弹窗
items.nameEn: Disable Sticky Keys and Toggle Keys prompts
items.description: 调整 StickyKeys / ToggleKeys 标志，关闭对应快捷键提示。
items.descriptionEn: Adjusts StickyKeys / ToggleKeys flags to disable their shortcut prompts.
items.sideEffect: 使用这些辅助功能的用户应保留原设置。
items.sideEffectEn: Keep the original settings if you use these accessibility features.

items.name: 开启硬件加速 GPU 计划（HAGS）
items.description: 将 HwSchMode 设为 2，启用硬件加速 GPU 调度，需系统、显卡和驱动支持。
items.descriptionEn: Sets HwSchMode to 2 for hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling, requiring OS, GPU and driver support.
items.sideEffect: 可能影响驱动稳定性与帧时间，重启后对照测试。
items.sideEffectEn: May affect driver stability and frame times; compare after restart.

items.name: 关闭窗口透明特效
items.description: 关闭任务栏/窗口亚克力透明，省一点 GPU 开销。
items.descriptionEn: Turns off taskbar and window acrylic transparency to save a little GPU overhead.
items.sideEffect: 桌面观感变朴素。
items.sideEffectEn: The desktop looks plainer.

items.name: 禁用游戏全屏优化
items.description: 为游戏主程序在 AppCompat 层加 DISABLEDXMAXIMIZEDWINDOWEDMODE，绕过全屏优化合成层。
items.descriptionEn: Adds DISABLEDXMAXIMIZEDWINDOWEDMODE at the AppCompat layer for the game executable, bypassing the fullscreen optimization composition layer.
items.sideEffect: Alt+Tab 切换可能略慢；需要先找到游戏主程序路径，找不到则跳过。
items.sideEffectEn: Alt+Tab may feel slightly slower. Requires locating the game executable; skipped if it cannot be found.

items.name: 游戏强制使用高性能 GPU
items.nameEn: Force games onto the high-performance GPU
items.description: 在 DirectX UserGpuPreferences 中把游戏指定到高性能 GPU（双显卡笔记本关键）。
items.descriptionEn: Assigns the game to the high-performance GPU in DirectX UserGpuPreferences. Important on dual-GPU laptops.

items.name: 禁用 MPO 多平面叠加
items.description: DWM OverlayTestMode=5，规避已知的 MPO 闪烁/掉帧问题。
items.descriptionEn: Sets DWM OverlayTestMode=5 to work around known MPO flicker and frame-drop issues.
items.sideEffect: 个别 HDR/多屏场景显示行为可能不同。
items.sideEffectEn: Some HDR or multi-monitor setups may behave differently.

items.name: 禁止显卡动态降频
items.description: 在主显卡驱动键写入 DisableDynamicPstate=1，进行动态频率策略实验。
items.descriptionEn: Writes DisableDynamicPstate=1 under the primary GPU driver key for a dynamic power-state experiment.
items.sideEffect: 行为依驱动而异，可能增加功耗与发热；默认不勾选。
items.sideEffectEn: Driver-dependent behavior may increase power draw and heat; unchecked by default.

items.name: 解除多媒体网络限流
items.description: 将 NetworkThrottlingIndex 设为 0xffffffff，调整多媒体网络节流策略。
items.descriptionEn: Sets NetworkThrottlingIndex to 0xffffffff to adjust multimedia network throttling.
items.sideEffect: 网络表现依负载和协议而异，建议对照测量。
items.sideEffectEn: Network behavior depends on workload and protocol; compare measurements.

items.name: 关闭 Nagle 算法(TcpAckFrequency)
items.description: 为 TCP/IP 接口写入 TCPNoDelay=1 和 TcpAckFrequency=1。
items.descriptionEn: Writes TCPNoDelay=1 and TcpAckFrequency=1 for TCP/IP interfaces.
items.sideEffect: 可能改变 TCP 小包与 ACK 行为；不直接作用于 UDP 流量。
items.sideEffectEn: May change TCP small-packet and ACK behavior; does not directly affect UDP traffic.

items.name: 关闭网卡节能
items.description: 对识别到的非虚拟网卡将 PnPCapabilities 的 0x18 位设为 1，调整设备节能策略。
items.descriptionEn: Sets the 0x18 bits of PnPCapabilities on detected nonvirtual adapters to adjust device power policy.
items.sideEffect: 行为依网卡驱动而异，可能增加空闲功耗。
items.sideEffectEn: Behavior depends on the network driver and may increase idle power draw.

items.name: 电源计划 → 卓越性能
items.description: 复制卓越性能模板并激活本工具创建的电源计划，备份原活动计划。
items.descriptionEn: Duplicates the Ultimate Performance template, activates the tool-created plan and saves the original active plan.
items.sideEffect: 可能增加功耗和发热，缩短电池续航。
items.sideEffectEn: May increase power draw and heat and shorten battery life.

items.name: 电源计划隐藏项调优
items.description: 调整捕获计划的接电设置：关闭 USB 选择性暂停，处理器提升模式设为激进。
items.descriptionEn: Adjusts the captured plan on AC: disables USB selective suspend and sets processor boost mode to aggressive.
items.sideEffect: 可能增加接电功耗与发热；原值读取失败时不写入。
items.sideEffectEn: May increase AC power draw and heat; an unreadable original blocks the write.

items.name: 关闭 PCIe 链路省电(ASPM)
items.nameEn: Disable PCIe link state power management (ASPM)
items.description: 关闭捕获电源计划的接电 PCIe 链路状态电源管理。
items.descriptionEn: Disables PCIe link-state power management in the captured plan on AC.
items.sideEffect: 可能增加接电功耗与温度。
items.sideEffectEn: May increase AC power draw and temperature.

items.name: 禁用 USB 选择性暂停
items.description: 写入 USB DisableSelectiveSuspend=1，调整全局 USB 选择性暂停策略。
items.descriptionEn: Writes USB DisableSelectiveSuspend=1 to adjust global USB selective-suspend policy.
items.sideEffect: 可能增加 USB 功耗，效果依系统和驱动支持情况而异。
items.sideEffectEn: May increase USB power draw; behavior depends on OS and driver support.

items.name: 开启 Windows 游戏模式
items.description: 允许系统在游戏运行时优先分配 CPU/GPU 资源。
items.descriptionEn: Lets Windows prioritise CPU and GPU resources while a game is running.

items.name: 关闭 Xbox 后台录制
items.description: 关掉 Game Bar 后台录制（DVR），减少游戏时的后台编码负载。
items.descriptionEn: Turns off Game Bar background recording (DVR) to cut background encoding load while gaming.
items.sideEffect: Win+G 录制/截图功能不可用。
items.sideEffectEn: Win+G recording and capture become unavailable.

items.name: 前台进程调度权重提升
items.description: Win32PrioritySeparation=0x28（短/变长量子、前台提升 2），让前台游戏进程获得更高调度优先级。
items.descriptionEn: Sets Win32PrioritySeparation=0x28 (short, variable-length quanta with foreground boost 2) so the foreground game gets higher scheduling priority.
items.sideEffect: 个别软件在后台时响应变慢。
items.sideEffectEn: A few applications may respond more slowly in the background.

items.name: 关闭 Windows 错误报告
items.description: 关闭 WER 弹窗与后台转储，减少崩溃时的磁盘/CPU 开销。
items.descriptionEn: Turns off WER dialogs and background dumps, cutting disk and CPU work when something crashes.
items.sideEffect: 程序崩溃时不再有系统级提示窗口。
items.sideEffectEn: No system-level prompt appears when a program crashes.

items.name: 系统后台响应保留设为最低
items.nameEn: Set system background responsiveness to minimum
items.description: SystemResponsiveness=10（MMCSS 文档允许的最低值），把更多 CPU 留给前台游戏。
items.descriptionEn: Sets SystemResponsiveness=10, the lowest value MMCSS documents, leaving more CPU for the foreground game.
items.sideEffect: 后台任务（解压、杀毒扫描）响应略慢。
items.sideEffectEn: Background tasks such as unzipping or antivirus scans respond a little more slowly.

items.name: MMCSS 游戏任务档位拉满
items.nameEn: Max out MMCSS game task priority
items.description: 调整 MMCSS Games 的 GPU Priority、Priority、Scheduling Category 和 SFIO Priority。
items.descriptionEn: Adjusts MMCSS Games GPU Priority, Priority, Scheduling Category and SFIO Priority.
items.sideEffect: 影响使用该 MMCSS 任务的应用，可能改变资源分配。
items.sideEffectEn: Affects applications using this MMCSS task and may change resource allocation.

items.name: 禁用 SysMain（预取）服务
items.description: 把 SysMain 服务启动类型设为禁用（Start=4）。SSD 时代预取收益有限，省一点后台 IO。
items.descriptionEn: Sets the SysMain service startup type to Disabled (Start=4). Prefetching buys little on SSDs, so this saves some background I/O.
items.sideEffect: 系统启动后程序冷启动略慢；默认不勾选。
items.sideEffectEn: Applications start a little more slowly after boot. Off by default.

items.name: 禁用 Windows Search 索引
items.description: 把 Windows Search 服务设为禁用（Start=4），减少索引后台占用。
items.descriptionEn: Sets the Windows Search service to Disabled (Start=4) to cut background indexing load.
items.sideEffect: 开始菜单/资源管理器搜索明显变慢；默认不勾选。
items.sideEffectEn: Start menu and File Explorer search become noticeably slower. Off by default.

items.name: 关闭休眠与快速启动
items.description: powercfg /h off，删除休眠文件并释放磁盘；休眠、混合睡眠及快速启动随之不可用。不会保证提升 FPS。
items.descriptionEn: Runs powercfg /h off to free disk space. Hibernation, hybrid sleep and Fast Startup become unavailable. No FPS improvement is guaranteed.
items.sideEffect: 恢复仅重新启用休眠功能，不能恢复已删除文件内容或原文件大小/类型；启动可能变慢，默认不勾选。
items.sideEffectEn: Restore only re-enables hibernation; deleted contents and the original file size/type are not restored. Boot may slow down. Off by default.

items.name: 游戏进程 CPU 优先级提到高
items.nameEn: Raise the game process CPU priority to High
items.description: 通过 IFEO PerfOptions 让游戏进程启动即以高优先级运行（CpuPriorityClass=3）。
items.descriptionEn: Uses IFEO PerfOptions to start the game process at High priority (CpuPriorityClass=3).
items.sideEffect: 对指定进程生效；多开/直播同机时可能影响其他程序。
items.sideEffectEn: Applies only to the specified process. May affect other programs when running multiple instances or streaming on the same machine.

items.name: 内核代码常驻内存
items.nameEn: Keep kernel code resident in memory
items.description: 将 DisablePagingExecutive 设为 1，调整可分页内核代码的驻留策略。
items.descriptionEn: Sets DisablePagingExecutive to 1 to adjust residency of pageable kernel code.
items.sideEffect: 可能增加常驻内存占用。
items.sideEffectEn: May increase resident memory use.

items.name: 内存压缩（暂不可用）
items.description: 暂不执行。EnableCompression 注册表写法未验证能控制内存压缩，保留旧备份还原支持。
items.descriptionEn: Currently unavailable. The former EnableCompression registry write does not verify control of memory compression; legacy restoration remains supported.
items.sideEffect: 待验证受支持的配置接口后开放。
items.sideEffectEn: Requires verification of a supported interface before enabling.

items.name: 禁用动态计时器
items.description: 将启动配置 disabledynamictick 设为 yes，禁用动态计时器。
items.descriptionEn: Sets the disabledynamictick boot option to yes to disable dynamic ticking.
items.sideEffect: 可能增加空闲功耗；重启生效，默认不勾选。
items.sideEffectEn: May increase idle power draw; requires restart and starts unchecked.

items.name: 菜单弹出零延迟
items.description: 将 MenuShowDelay 设为 0，缩短菜单弹出等待。
items.descriptionEn: Sets MenuShowDelay to 0 to shorten menu opening delay.
items.sideEffect: 菜单响应节奏会改变。
items.sideEffectEn: Changes menu response timing.

items.name: 视觉效果最佳性能
items.description: 将 Windows 视觉效果方案切换为"调整为最佳性能"，关闭动画与花哨特效，桌面合成开销降到最低。
items.descriptionEn: Switches the Windows visual effects scheme to Adjust for best performance, turning off animations and decorative effects to minimise desktop composition overhead.
items.sideEffect: 窗口动画、阴影等观感变朴素；可在系统"性能选项"调回。
items.sideEffectEn: Window animations and shadows disappear, so the desktop looks plainer. Revert under Windows Performance Options.

items.name: 关闭传递优化 P2P 上传
items.description: 将传递优化 DODownloadMode 设为 0，关闭其对等下载模式。
items.descriptionEn: Sets Delivery Optimization DODownloadMode to 0 to disable its peer-to-peer download mode.
items.sideEffect: 不再从其他设备获取传递优化内容。
items.sideEffectEn: Delivery Optimization no longer retrieves content from peer devices.

items.name: 限制应用后台活动
items.description: 将 GlobalUserDisabled 设为 1，限制支持此策略的应用后台活动。
items.descriptionEn: Sets GlobalUserDisabled to 1 to restrict background activity in applications supporting this policy.
items.sideEffect: 可能影响通知与同步；不控制所有 Win32 后台进程。
items.sideEffectEn: May affect notifications and sync; does not control all Win32 background processes.

items.name: 关闭诊断遥测
items.description: 将 AllowTelemetry 设为 0；最低诊断级别取决于 Windows 版本和版本类型。
items.descriptionEn: Sets AllowTelemetry to 0; the effective minimum diagnostic level depends on Windows version and edition.
items.sideEffect: 可能影响诊断与反馈；不代表关闭所有网络请求。
items.sideEffectEn: May affect diagnostics and feedback; does not disable all network requests.
